name: Caos Primordial
label: Esferas
description: Fire THREE distinct spherical projectiles to the RIGHT. The core compresses and charges, then the right-facing aperture ejects small bone-white glowing SPHERES one after another. Three clearly separate solid round energy balls travel horizontally from the aperture across the empty right half of the frame and exit the right edge. Slight recoil of the entity, then recover to idle. No expanding shockwave around the body. STRICT side-scroller view facing RIGHT for every frame, never turn toward camera. Clear anticipation, strong action and recovery. Preserve identity and crisp bone-silver charcoal pixel art, no new colors. Keep full sprite and moving weapons inside 256x192, same planted baseline, same scale. Static camera. Transparent. Stay in place; no camera pan.
